title: Snapshot transports before awaiting writer drains
answers: Why can draining proxy connection writes fail when transports change?
How does ConnectionHandler.drain_writers avoid an iteration race?
Should transport iteration use a snapshot when awaiting writer drains?
body:
Symptom: Draining proxy connection writes can fail when transports change during drainage.
Root cause: mitmproxy/proxy/server.py:ConnectionHandler.drain_writers iterated the live self.transports.values() view across await transport.writer.drain().
Fix pattern: Snapshot the transport values with list(self.transports.values()) before iterating across awaits.
Constraints: This addresses changes to collection membership during drainage; preserve the existing _drain_lock and writer-is-not-None guard.
applies: ConnectionHandler transport iteration that awaits writer drainage.
